topic: Putting a vet emergency on a credit card vs building a pet emergency fund (Gregory vs Eugenia)

scenes.narration: One vet emergency costs more than a year of pet food. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a dog leash beside a vet bill and a jar labeled PET FUND, comic burst banner reads ONE EMERGENCY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gregory and Eugenia both adopt a lab puppy the same weekend.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man gregory and woman eugenia each hugging a yellow lab puppy, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both know dogs get sick. Only one plans for it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two puppies with a thought bubble showing a vet building, one owner with a plan, one shrugging, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gregory figures he will deal with it if it happens.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gregory shrugging with a speech banner reading I WILL FIGURE IT OUT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Year two, the dog eats a sock. Surgery costs thirty two hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a lab on a vet table, a sock in an x ray, a bill reading THIRTY TWO HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: It goes on a card at twenty six percent and takes two years to clear.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man gregory swiping a card, a statement climbing with a tag reading TWENTY SIX PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Eugenia opens a pet fund and automates fifty dollars a month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman eugenia setting an automatic transfer reading FIFTY MONTHLY into an account labeled PET FUND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She also prices pet insurance and picks a basic accident plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman eugenia comparing insurance plans on a laptop, one card reads ACCIDENT PLAN TWENTY MONTHLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Year two, her dog eats the same sock. Same surgery, same bill.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a second lab on a vet table with the same sock x ray, same bill, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Insurance pays seventy percent. The pet fund covers the rest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a bill with lines reading INSURANCE PAID SEVENTY PERCENT and PET FUND PAID THE REST, stamped PAID, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Gregory paid four thousand with interest. Eugenia paid nothing out of pocket.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man gregory beside a statement reading FOUR THOUSAND, woman eugenia playing fetch with her dog, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fifty a month beats a surprise bill. Fund the pet. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading FUND THE PET, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
